about: The Notion connector against a fake Notion (docs/connectors/notion-design.md), run by every port that has the connector (python/tests/test_notion.py). The fake is built from `tree` (a case may have its own): a page is {title, text, children}, a database {database, schema: {property: type}, rows: [{title, props, text}]}; ids are given in creation order, depth first: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, ...; the clock starts at 2026-01-01T00:00 and moves only with `tick` (seconds). The root page is mounted at /mnt/n in `mode` with token secret-token. Steps: run (stdout, stderr, exitCode), changes (the pending change set; content as text), apply (paths applied, the one it stopped at, conflict, the error text), notion (the fake's outline), edit / trash (someone changes Notion), tick, refresh, fault (the next `times` requests of `method` whose path matches the regex `path` get `status`, `headers`, `body`).

cases.name: what Notion can't do is refused

expect.stderr: mount: /mnt/n/Meeting Notes: /Meeting Notes: Notion can't move databases; only rename one where it is; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)
mount: /mnt/n/Wiki/notes.txt: /Wiki/notes.txt: only .md files can be Notion pages; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)
mount: /mnt/n/Wiki/bin.md: /Wiki/bin.md: Notion pages hold UTF-8 text; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)

mount: /mnt/n/Wiki/Onboarding.md: /Wiki/Onboarding.md: subpages and databases are folders here; a page's text can't add or change <page> or <database> tags; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)
mount: /mnt/n/Projects/index.md: /Projects/index.md: index.md is the page's own text; move or rename its folder instead; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)
mount: /mnt/n/Meeting Notes/Archive: /Meeting Notes/Archive: a database holds rows: write NAME.md files in it; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)
mount: /mnt/n/Projects/Website Redesign: /Projects/Website Redesign: a page with subpages can't become a database row; the change stays pending (mount --discard /mnt/n drops your changes)
